title: File control: DELETE of a record by RIDFLD, after READ UPDATE with no RIDFLD, and GENERIC with KEYLENGTH; NOTFND RESP2 80 and INVREQ RESP2 31

scenarios.summary: DELETE RIDFLD removes a record (a READ of it is NOTFND); deleting it again or an absent key is NOTFND RESP2 80; a neighbour is untouched
READ UPDATE then DELETE with no RIDFLD removes the held record; a DELETE with no RIDFLD and nothing held is INVREQ RESP2 31
DELETE GENERIC KEYLENGTH removes every record with the key prefix and no others; a generic delete matching nothing is NOTFND RESP2 80
